name: Hue Tap dial (t)
info:
This node takes the output of a Home Assistant
*Events: all* node, set to capture events of
the `zha_event` kind, and if the device' IEEE
address matches the property `device_ieee` set
on this node's instance, then the events are
treated as Philips Hue Tap dial events, and
they are processed and routed to the respective
outputs.  The `msg.payload` coming through the
output will have at least a `command` property
which will be used to route to each output
as denoted below.  It may also have a property
`last_clicked_button` which contains an integer
number between 1 and 4 representing the button
you last clicked; you can use this value to make
decisions on what to do with the outputs of
this node.

There are six outputs in this node:

1. `command=up`: the dial was turned
   clockwise; the `step_size` property
   will contain by how much (in an arbitrary
   unit-less value)
2. `command=down`: the dial was turned
   counterclockwise; rotation angle works
   as for `command=up`
3. `command=click`: a button was clicked;
   the property `button` contains the button
   number (1 through 4)
4. `command=doubleclick`: a button was double-
   clicked (> 250 ms between taps)
5. `command=tripleclick`: a button was triple-
   clicked
6. the event does not correspond to any known
   device events

name: Pause / resume media players
info:
This node allows you to pause and resume
media players.  If the message contains
a property "action" set to "pause", it
will pause your media players.  If the
action contains "resume", it will
resume the media players that were
paused by this flow before.  The output
will contain a property "action"
("paused" / "resumed") if any action
was taken.  If no action is in the
message, this will toggle between pausing
all media players and resuming all
media players.

List property `ignore_media_players` in the
`msg` will cause all listed media players to be
ignored by this node.  Those media
players will never be considered for
pause / resume functionality.

Mode can be "all" (pause all media players
then unpause all that were paused) or
"last" (pause the most recently playing
media player and unpause the most
recently paused media player).  The first
mode is useful when you go away / return
and the second mode is useful with a
remote control.
